prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash depicts a quiet theatre backstage. On the left, a woman in a velvet dress sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in exhaustion. Next to her, a man in a red scarf stands holding a script, his gaze fixed on the pages. In the center, a tall ladder leans against the brick wall, its rungs worn from use. To the right of the ladder, a black cat crouches low, its eyes wide and alert. Beside the cat, a large spotlight rests on the floor, its lens dusty. The man in the red scarf is handing a page to the woman in the velvet dress, who reaches out to take it. The black cat is looking at the large spotlight, seemingly curious about the object. There is no audience visible in this intimate behind-the-scenes moment. The scene captures the stillness before the performance begins, with the distinct elements arranged clearly within the space. The light wash adds subtle warmth to the otherwise monochrome lines, highlighting the textures of the velvet and the rough brick.
